armor.name: Solar Flare Armor
armor.why: This is the best pre-Moon Lord melee armor because the survivability and shield charges are absurdly strong.

armor.name: Beetle Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Beetle Husks and Turtle Armor
armor.why: If you cannot craft Solar immediately, Beetle remains a very respectable carry-over for the phase.

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: It remains the default best melee accessory even at this point because the package is still so efficient.

accessories.name: Destroyer Emblem
accessories.why: The damage and crit boost continue to scale very well with Solar fragment weapons.

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: They are the standout mobility option before Moon Lord if you have access to them.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.why: The dodge and dash are still extremely valuable against pillar swarms and Moon Lord patterns.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.source: Crafted from Celestial Stone and Moon Charm.
accessories.why: An all-stats boost that also shifts helpfully with day and night.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Crafted from Obsidian Shield and Ankh Charm.
accessories.why: Knockback immunity and immunity to most debuffs for the hardest fights.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.why: The defense shred still gives melee the best practical damage boost per buff slot.

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.why: Extra health is hugely valuable as the fights become longer and less forgiving.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.why: A direct damage increase helps shorten both pillar clears and the Moon Lord attempt itself.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.why: The crit boost is another high-value late-game damage lever once your base weapon power is already huge.

weapons.name: Phantasm
weapons.why: Charges up to fire additional phantom arrows the longer it is held.

armor.name: Vortex Armor
armor.why: This is the best pre-Moon Lord ranger armor because it finally upgrades Shroomite into true Lunar-tier offense.

armor.name: Shroomite Armor
armor.why: It stays a credible fallback until Vortex crafting is online.

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: It remains the top ranger accessory because precision and crit both stay premium all the way to Moon Lord.

accessories.name: Ranger Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: A direct damage boost still fits naturally into the end of the progression curve.

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: They remain the premium mobility choice before Moon Lord if you have access to them.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: The stat boost is still worth carrying once your core class accessory slots are already settled.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Crafted from Obsidian Shield and Ankh Charm.
accessories.why: Knockback immunity and immunity to most debuffs for the hardest fights.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.source: Crafted from Tabi, Black Belt, and Climbing Claws (Tinkerer).
accessories.why: Dash, a dodge chance, and wall-climb in a single slot.

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.why: It is still the highest-value simple ranger buff because Phantasm and Tsunami both make great use of it.

buffs.name: Crystal Bullets
buffs.why: The research explicitly calls out premium ammo at this stage, and Crystal Bullets remain a great default choice.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.why: Ammo savings matter once your best weapons are firing constantly through pillar clears and Moon Lord attempts.

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.why: It is still easy free value before every important fight.

weapons.name: Nebula Blaze
weapons.source: Crafted from 18 Nebula Fragments at an Ancient Manipulator (fragments drop from the Nebula Pillar)
weapons.why: Fires homing star projectiles with a chance to fire a stronger high-damage shot.

weapons.name: Nebula Arcanum
weapons.why: Fires slow homing orbs that spawn additional star projectiles.

armor.name: Nebula Armor
armor.why: This is the obvious pre-Moon Lord mage set because the Lunar-tier bonuses finally outclass Spectre.

armor.name: Spectre Armor
armor.why: Spectre remains a strong fallback if your Nebula fragment progression is not finished yet.

accessories.name: Celestial Emblem
accessories.why: It stays the default mage accessory because the damage and mana support remain universally useful.

accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.why: Auto-potions are still a major execution aid during the longest fights in the run.

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: Mage gets a lot out of the smoother aerial control these provide.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: The all-around stat lift is still worth a slot once the rest of your loadout is stable.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Crafted from Obsidian Shield and Ankh Charm.
accessories.why: Knockback immunity and immunity to most debuffs for the hardest fights.

accessories.name: Charm of Myths
accessories.source: Crafted from Band of Regeneration and Philosopher's Stone.
accessories.why: Steady life regen and a shorter healing-potion cooldown keep you topped up.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.why: It remains the best simple mage damage buff and belongs in every serious late-game attempt.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: Mana sustain is still crucial because the best Lunar mage tools can drain resources very quickly.

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: This remains free power before every pillar or Moon Lord attempt.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Extra survivability is still worth taking because the phase can punish fragile builds instantly.

weapons.name: Stardust Cell Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 18 Stardust Fragments at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: Summons Stardust Cell minions that fire homing projectiles and apply a stacking debuff.

weapons.name: Stardust Dragon Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 18 Stardust Fragments at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: Summons a segmented Stardust Dragon that grows with each additional summon.

weapons.name: Constellation
weapons.source: Crafted (18 Stardust Fragment at an Ancient Manipulator)
weapons.why: Crafted from Stardust Fragments and fires homing star projectiles on hit.

armor.name: Stardust Armor
armor.why: This is the obvious best pre-Moon Lord summoner set because the Guardian and extra slot are both huge.

armor.name: Tiki Armor
armor.why: It remains a workable fallback until Stardust crafting is done.

accessories.name: Papyrus Scarab
accessories.why: It is still the best summoner accessory because extra minion value and direct summon scaling are both premium.

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.why: An extra minion slot remains simple, high-impact value right through the Lunar stretch.

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: The mobility keeps paying off because summoner still wins by surviving long enough for minions to work.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: The all-around stat bonus supports both summon output and your own survivability during chaotic pillar fights.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Crafted from Obsidian Shield and Ankh Charm.
accessories.why: Knockback immunity and immunity to most debuffs for the hardest fights.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.source: Crafted from Tabi, Black Belt, and Climbing Claws (Tinkerer).
accessories.why: Dash, a dodge chance, and wall-climb in a single slot.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.why: An extra minion is still the best buff you can possibly bring to a summoner setup.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: It remains mandatory because it stacks perfectly with every other summoner advantage.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Summoner still wants as much survivability padding as it can get during the Moon Lord lead-up.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: The damage reduction is very welcome when pillar mobs and Moon Lord patterns start overlapping badly.
